card.name: Dose arithmetic and schedule adjustment words
card.fires_on: Small words like "by", "the" or "adjust" in dosing instructions where a dose is multiplied or divided, or a missed dose shifts the schedule.

modes.label: Multiply or divide a dose
modes.description: The word "by" after a dose or volume, when converting daily to weekly or hourly amounts.
modes.example: the weekly dose may be calculated by multiplying the daily oral dose<< by>> 7 and given as a single intr

modes.label: Missed-dose schedule shift
modes.description: Words like "the" or "adjust" in missed-dose rules that refer to the next scheduled dose or the schedule.
modes.example: If a planned dose of VYXEOS is missed, administer the dose as soon as possible and<< adjust>> the dosing schedule accordingly

card.writes: Little clear effect; it weakly suppresses recurring-interval words like periodic, weekly, yearly.
card.plain: It marks spots in dosing text where a dose is being divided, multiplied or rescheduled.
